experiment: E4f KITTI outdoor geometry consistency diagnostic
reason: Driving sequences contain moving vehicles and other dynamic objects. Their RGB/LiDAR disagreement could be confused with static geometry error.
change: Use official KITTI tracklet 3D boxes only to mask dynamic-object LiDAR samples and corresponding projected image pixels in evaluation.
unchanged: pre-registered sequence candidate order and 240-frame selection rule
prohibited_uses: tracklet labels are not passed to the model, tracker, retrieval, mapping, Gaussian filtering, or rendering
tracklet labels do not choose frames or tune evaluation thresholds
unlabeled objects are not assumed static
coverage_rule: Report labeled-dynamic exclusion before/after coverage; if static-surface sample count is insufficient, mark that metric INCONCLUSIVE without relaxing the mask after model output.
